<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Solar System</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { background: #000; overflow: hidden; font-family: Georgia, serif; touch-action: none; }
  #canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }

  #hud {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent);
    pointer-events: none; z-index: 10;
  }
  #title { color: #e8d5a0; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.9; }
  #hud-right { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; pointer-events: none; }

  /* Speed control */
  /* Find Moon button */
  #find-moon-btn {
    position: fixed; bottom: 90px; left: 18px;
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: opacity 0.35s, background 0.2s;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  }
  #find-moon-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #find-moon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); }
  #find-moon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

  /* Find Moon panel */
  #find-moon-panel {
    position: fixed; bottom: 140px; left: 18px;
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(8,8,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 12px 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    min-width: 180px;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.97);
    transition: opacity 0.28s, transform 0.28s;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  #find-moon-panel.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  #find-moon-panel-title {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: center; margin-bottom: 8px; padding-bottom: 7px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  }
  .moon-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
    padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 9px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .moon-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); color: #fff; }
  .moon-item:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
  .moon-emoji { font-size: 13px; }

  #speed-control {
    position: fixed; bottom: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 50px; padding: 10px 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
  }
  #speed-control label { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  #speed-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none; width: 120px; height: 2px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 2px; outline: none;
  }
  #speed-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: #e8d5a0; cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* Selection popup — name + Visit button */
  #selection-popup {
    position: fixed; bottom: 100px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.35s, transform 0.35s;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
  }
  #selection-popup.visible {
    opacity: 1; pointer-events: all;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }
  #sel-name {
    color: #e8d5a0; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 5px; text-transform: uppercase;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(232,213,160,0.6);
  }
  #visit-btn {
    background: rgba(232,213,160,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,213,160,0.5);
    color: #e8d5a0;
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 9px 24px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  #visit-btn:hover { background: rgba(232,213,160,0.3); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(232,213,160,0.3); }
  #visit-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

  /* Back button — shown when locked to a body */
  #back-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 9px 22px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s;
  }
  #back-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #back-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
  #back-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }

  /* Venus cloud toggle button */
  #venus-toggle-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 106px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(255, 210, 120, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 210, 120, 0.45);
    color: rgba(255, 210, 120, 0.9);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #venus-toggle-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #venus-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,210,120,0.22); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,210,120,0.25); }
  #venus-toggle-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }
  #venus-toggle-btn.surface-mode {
    background: rgba(200, 140, 60, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(200,140,60,0.55);
    color: rgba(220,170,80,0.9);
  }

  /* Moon teleport toggle button */
  #moon-toggle-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 106px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(200, 200, 210, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(200, 200, 210, 0.4);
    color: rgba(210, 210, 220, 0.9);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #moon-toggle-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #moon-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(200,200,210,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(200,200,210,0.2); }
  #moon-toggle-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }
  #moon-toggle-btn.on-moon {
    background: rgba(160,160,175,0.2);
    border-color: rgba(180,180,195,0.55);
    color: rgba(220,220,230,1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(180,180,195,0.3);
  }

  /* Triton visit button (Neptune) */
  #triton-toggle-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 152px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(80, 130, 200, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(100, 160, 220, 0.4);
    color: rgba(140, 190, 240, 0.9);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #triton-toggle-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #triton-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(100,160,220,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(100,160,220,0.2); }
  #triton-toggle-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }
  #triton-toggle-btn.on-triton { background: rgba(60,100,160,0.22); border-color: rgba(80,140,200,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(80,140,200,0.25); }

  /* Charon visit button (Pluto) */
  #charon-toggle-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 106px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(160, 140, 130, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(180, 160, 145, 0.4);
    color: rgba(210, 195, 180, 0.9);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #charon-toggle-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #charon-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(180,160,145,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(180,160,145,0.2); }
  #charon-toggle-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }
  #charon-toggle-btn.on-charon { background: rgba(130,110,100,0.22); border-color: rgba(170,150,135,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(160,140,130,0.25); }

  /* Neptune texture toggle button */
  #neptune-toggle-btn {
    position: fixed; top: 106px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(80, 130, 200, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(100, 160, 220, 0.45);
    color: rgba(140, 190, 240, 0.95);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #neptune-toggle-btn.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #neptune-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(100,160,220,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(100,160,220,0.25); }
  #neptune-toggle-btn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); }
  #neptune-toggle-btn.true-color {
    background: rgba(60, 100, 160, 0.22);
    border-color: rgba(80, 140, 200, 0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(80,140,200,0.3);
  }

  /* Locked indicator */
  #lock-label {
    position: fixed; top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    color: #e8d5a0; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 5px; text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.4s;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232,213,160,0.5);
    z-index: 10;
  }
  #lock-label.visible { opacity: 1; }

  /* Find Object button */
  #find-btn {
    position: fixed; bottom: 90px; right: 18px;
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: opacity 0.35s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  }
  #find-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
  #find-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
  #find-btn.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  #find-btn .find-icon { font-size: 13px; }

  /* Find Object panel */
  #find-panel {
    position: fixed; bottom: 140px; right: 18px;
    z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(8, 8, 18, 0.88);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 14px 10px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    min-width: 190px;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.97);
    transition: opacity 0.28s, transform 0.28s;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  #find-panel.visible {
    opacity: 1; pointer-events: all;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  #find-panel-title {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  }
  .find-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .find-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #fff; }
  .find-item:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }
  .find-dot {
    width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .find-divider {
    height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    margin: 4px 8px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="canvas"></canvas>

<div id="hud">
  <div id="title">Solar System</div>
  <div id="hud-right">DRAG TO ROTATE</div>
</div>

<div id="lock-label"></div>
<button id="back-btn">← Back to Overview</button>
<button id="venus-toggle-btn">☁ Hide Clouds</button>
<button id="moon-toggle-btn">🌙 Visit Moon</button>
<button id="neptune-toggle-btn">🔵 True Color</button>
<button id="triton-toggle-btn">🌑 Visit Triton</button>
<button id="charon-toggle-btn">🪐 Visit Charon</button>

<div id="selection-popup">
  <div id="sel-name"></div>
  <button id="visit-btn">Visit →</button>
</div>

<div id="speed-control">
  <label>Speed</label>
  <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="1">
</div>

<button id="find-btn"><span class="find-icon">🔭</span> Find Object</button>
<button id="find-moon-btn">🌙 Moons</button>
<div id="find-moon-panel"><div id="find-moon-panel-title">Moons</div><div id="moon-list"></div></div>

<div id="find-panel">
  <div id="find-panel-title">Navigate To</div>

  <div class="find-item" data-body="Sun">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff7aa, #ffcc00, #ff8800);box-shadow:0 0 6px #ffaa00;"></div>
    The Sun
  </div>
  <div class="find-divider"></div>

  <div class="find-item" data-body="Mercury">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #d4c5b0, #8a7a6a);"></div>
    Mercury
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Venus">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #f5e0a0, #c8800a);"></div>
    Venus
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Earth">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #88ccff, #2255aa, #33aa44);"></div>
    Earth
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Mars">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #e08060, #992211);"></div>
    Mars
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Jupiter">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #e8d0b0, #c09060, #aa6633);"></div>
    Jupiter
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Saturn">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #f5eaaa, #c8a844);"></div>
    Saturn
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Uranus">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #b8e8ee, #5599aa);"></div>
    Uranus
  </div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Neptune">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #6688ee, #223399);"></div>
    Neptune
  </div>
  <div class="find-divider"></div>
  <div class="find-item" data-body="Pluto">
    <div class="find-dot" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #d4c0a8, #7a6050);"></div>
    Pluto
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
const TEXTURES = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  phobos: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  deimos: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  io: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  europa: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  ganymede: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  callisto: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mimas: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  enceladus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  titan: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  iapetus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  oberon: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  titania: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  miranda: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  ariel: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  triton: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  charon: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune_true: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  moon: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  pluto: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus_clouds: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth_clouds: "data:image/png;base64,",
  saturn_rings: "data:image/png;base64,",
  uranus_rings: "data:image/png;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
};

const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.set(0, 60, 130);
camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
function loadTex(key) { return loader.load(TEXTURES[key]); }

// Stars
const starGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
const starCount = 3500;
const starPos = new Float32Array(starCount * 3);
for (let i = 0; i < starCount * 3; i++) starPos[i] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1800;
starGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(starPos, 3));
scene.add(new THREE.Points(starGeo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, size: 0.5, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8 })));

// Sun
const sunTex = loadTex('sun');
const sun = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.SphereGeometry(8, 40, 40),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: sunTex })
);
const sunGlow = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.SphereGeometry(9.8, 32, 32),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff9900, transparent: true, opacity: 0.12, side: THREE.BackSide })
);
sun.add(sunGlow);

scene.add(new THREE.PointLight(0xfff5d0, 2.5, 600));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x111133, 0.5));


const systemGroup = new THREE.Group();
systemGroup.add(sun);
scene.add(systemGroup);

const planetData = [
  { name: 'Mercury', tex: 'mercury', size: 0.8,  orbit: 20,  speed: 4.7,  tilt: 0.03 },
  { name: 'Venus',   tex: 'venus',   size: 1.4,  orbit: 28,  speed: 3.5,  tilt: 2.64 },
  { name: 'Earth',   tex: 'earth',   size: 1.5,  orbit: 38,  speed: 2.9,  tilt: 0.41, atmos: true },
  { name: 'Mars',    tex: 'mars',    size: 1.1,  orbit: 52,  speed: 2.4,  tilt: 0.44 },
  { name: 'Jupiter', tex: 'jupiter', size: 4.5,  orbit: 80,  speed: 1.3,  tilt: 0.05 },
  { name: 'Saturn',  tex: 'saturn',  size: 3.8,  orbit: 108, speed: 0.96, tilt: 0.47, rings: true },
  { name: 'Uranus',  tex: 'uranus',  size: 2.5,  orbit: 134, speed: 0.68, tilt: 1.7177, uranusRings: true },
  { name: 'Neptune', tex: 'neptune', size: 2.3,  orbit: 158, speed: 0.54, tilt: 0.49 },
  { name: 'Pluto',   tex: 'pluto',   size: 0.7,  orbit: 180, speed: 0.38, tilt: 0.12 },
];

const planets = [];

planetData.forEach(data => {
  const orbitMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.RingGeometry(data.orbit - 0.06, data.orbit + 0.06, 128),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.07, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
  );
  orbitMesh.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  systemGroup.add(orbitMesh);

  const pivot = new THREE.Object3D();
  pivot.rotation.y = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  systemGroup.add(pivot);

  const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: loadTex(data.tex), shininess: 12, specular: 0x111111 });
  const planet = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.size, 32, 32), mat);
  planet.position.x = data.orbit;
  planet.rotation.z = data.tilt;
  pivot.add(planet);

  if (data.atmos) {
    // Cloud layer — white pixels = clouds, black = transparent via alphaMap
    const cloudTex = loadTex('earth_clouds');
    const cloudMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.size * 1.012, 48, 48),
      new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
        map: cloudTex,
        alphaMap: cloudTex,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.88,
        depthWrite: false,
        shininess: 5
      })
    );
    cloudMesh.userData.isCloud = true;
    planet.add(cloudMesh);

    // Thin blue atmosphere rim
    planet.add(new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.size * 1.06, 32, 32),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4499ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08, side: THREE.BackSide })
    ));
  }
  if (data.rings) {
    // Saturn — textured ring using top-down ring map
    const satRingTex = loadTex('saturn_rings');
    satRingTex.wrapS = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
    satRingTex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
    const rg = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(data.size*1.35, data.size*2.8, 128),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: satRingTex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.92, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
    );
    rg.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    planet.add(rg);
  }
  if (data.uranusRings) {
    // Uranus — rings tilted ~97.77 degrees (nearly sideways)
    const uraRingTex = loadTex('uranus_rings');
    uraRingTex.wrapS = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
    uraRingTex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
    const urRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(data.size*1.6, data.size*2.9, 128),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: uraRingTex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.75, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
    );
    // Uranus axial tilt is 97.77 deg — rings are in equatorial plane, nearly perpendicular to orbit
    urRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; // flat in equatorial plane
    planet.add(urRing);
  }

  // Venus cloud atmosphere layer
  if (data.name === 'Venus') {
    const vCloudTex = loadTex('venus_clouds');
    const vCloudMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.size * 1.025, 48, 48),
      new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
        map: vCloudTex,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.92,
        depthWrite: false,
        shininess: 8
      })
    );
    vCloudMesh.userData.isVenusClouds = true;
    planet.add(vCloudMesh);
  }
  planets.push({ pivot, planet, data });
});

}

// ─── Mars Moons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const MARS_MOONS = [
  { key: 'phobos',  name: 'Phobos',  size: 0.18, orbit: 1.4,  speed: 2.2,  emoji: '🪨' },
  { key: 'deimos',  name: 'Deimos',  size: 0.12, orbit: 2.1,  speed: 1.4,  emoji: '🪨' },
];
const JUPITER_MOONS = [
  { key: 'io',       name: 'Io',       size: 0.55, orbit: 6.5,  speed: 2.0,  emoji: '🌋' },
  { key: 'europa',   name: 'Europa',   size: 0.48, orbit: 8.5,  speed: 1.5,  emoji: '🧊' },
  { key: 'ganymede', name: 'Ganymede', size: 0.72, orbit: 11.0, speed: 1.1,  emoji: '⚫' },
  { key: 'callisto', name: 'Callisto', size: 0.65, orbit: 14.0, speed: 0.75, emoji: '🌑' },
];
const SATURN_MOONS = [
  { key: 'mimas',     name: 'Mimas',     size: 0.22, orbit: 14.0, speed: 2.2,  emoji: '⚪' },
  { key: 'enceladus', name: 'Enceladus', size: 0.28, orbit: 16.5, speed: 1.8,  emoji: '❄️' },
  { key: 'titan',     name: 'Titan',     size: 0.75, orbit: 20.5, speed: 1.1,  emoji: '🟠', hasTitanAtmos: true },
  { key: 'iapetus',   name: 'Iapetus',   size: 0.45, orbit: 27.0, speed: 0.6,  emoji: '⚫' },
];
const URANUS_MOONS = [
  { key: 'miranda', name: 'Miranda', size: 0.22, orbit: 4.2,  speed: 2.1,  emoji: '🌑' },
  { key: 'ariel',   name: 'Ariel',   size: 0.32, orbit: 5.5,  speed: 1.7,  emoji: '⚪' },
  { key: 'titania', name: 'Titania', size: 0.42, orbit: 7.5,  speed: 1.2,  emoji: '⚪' },
  { key: 'oberon',  name: 'Oberon',  size: 0.40, orbit: 9.5,  speed: 0.9,  emoji: '⚪' },
];

// Store all planet moon systems: { planetName, moons: [{moonData, pivot, mesh}] }
const planetMoonSystems = [];

function createMoonSystem(planetEntry, moonDataList) {
  const moons = [];
  moonDataList.forEach(md => {
    const pivot = new THREE.Object3D();
    pivot.rotation.y = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    planetEntry.planet.add(pivot);

    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(md.size, 24, 24),
      new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: loadTex(md.key), shininess: 4 })
    );
    mesh.position.x = md.orbit;
    mesh.userData.isMoon = true;
    mesh.userData.moonName = md.name;
    mesh.userData.moonSize = md.size;
    pivot.add(mesh);

    // Titan green atmosphere
    if (md.hasTitanAtmos) {
      const atmMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(md.size * 1.18, 24, 24),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x88cc44, transparent: true, opacity: 0.22, side: THREE.BackSide })
      );
      mesh.add(atmMesh);
      // Outer haze ring
      const hazeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(md.size * 1.32, 24, 24),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x99aa22, transparent: true, opacity: 0.07, side: THREE.BackSide })
      );
      mesh.add(hazeMesh);
    }

    // Faint orbit ring
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(md.orbit - 0.02, md.orbit + 0.02, 64),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.05, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    planetEntry.planet.add(ring);

    moons.push({ data: md, pivot, mesh });
  });
  return moons;
}

{
  const marsEntry    = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Mars');
  const jupiterEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Jupiter');
  const saturnEntry  = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Saturn');
  const uranusEntry  = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Uranus');

  if (marsEntry)    planetMoonSystems.push({ planetName: 'Mars',    moons: createMoonSystem(marsEntry, MARS_MOONS) });
  if (jupiterEntry) planetMoonSystems.push({ planetName: 'Jupiter', moons: createMoonSystem(jupiterEntry, JUPITER_MOONS) });
  if (saturnEntry)  planetMoonSystems.push({ planetName: 'Saturn',  moons: createMoonSystem(saturnEntry, SATURN_MOONS) });
  if (uranusEntry)  planetMoonSystems.push({ planetName: 'Uranus',  moons: createMoonSystem(uranusEntry, URANUS_MOONS) });
}

// ─── Charon (Pluto's Moon) — Pluto-Charon Barycenter ─────────────────────────
// Pluto & Charon orbit their common barycenter. Charon is ~12% Pluto's mass,
// so barycenter sits about 2133 km from Pluto center (~halfway between them).
// We model this by having both Pluto and Charon orbit the same pivot point.
let charonMesh = null;
let charonPivot = null; // pivot at barycenter, attached to Pluto's orbit pivot
const CHARON_SYSTEM_RADIUS = 2.6;  // half-separation (both offset from center)
const PLUTO_OFFSET = 0.9;          // Pluto offset from barycenter (smaller — heavier)
const CHARON_OFFSET = 1.7;         // Charon offset from barycenter (larger — lighter)
const CHARON_SIZE = 0.52;          // ~slightly smaller than Pluto (0.7)

{
  const plutoEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Pluto');
  if (plutoEntry) {
    // Fix: use a barycenterGroup positioned at orbit radius.
    // Pluto mesh and Charon both live inside it, offset in opposite directions.
    // The planet mesh was originally at position.x = orbit (132).
    // Remove it from pivot, create barycenterGroup at that orbit position instead.

    const orbitRadius = plutoEntry.planet.position.x; // = 132 (data.orbit)

    // Create barycenter group — sits at orbit position, rotates for mutual orbit
    charonPivot = new THREE.Object3D();
    charonPivot.position.x = orbitRadius;
    plutoEntry.pivot.add(charonPivot);

    // Move Pluto mesh into barycenterGroup, offset from center
    plutoEntry.pivot.remove(plutoEntry.planet);
    plutoEntry.planet.position.x = PLUTO_OFFSET;   // small offset from barycenter
    plutoEntry.planet.position.y = 0;
    plutoEntry.planet.position.z = 0;
    charonPivot.add(plutoEntry.planet);

    // Charon on opposite side of barycenter
    charonMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(CHARON_SIZE, 28, 28),
      new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: loadTex('charon'), shininess: 4 })
    );
    charonMesh.position.x = -CHARON_OFFSET;
    charonMesh.userData.isCharon = true;
    charonPivot.add(charonMesh);

    // Faint mutual orbit ring around barycenter
    const charonRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(CHARON_SYSTEM_RADIUS - 0.02, CHARON_SYSTEM_RADIUS + 0.02, 64),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xbbbbcc, transparent: true, opacity: 0.06, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    charonRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    charonPivot.add(charonRing);
  }
}

// ─── Camera State Machine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// mode: 'overview' | 'transitioning' | 'locked'
let mode = 'overview';

// Overview orbit controls
let isDragging = false, prevMouse = {x:0,y:0};
let rotX = 0.3, rotY = 0, targetRotX = 0.3, targetRotY = 0;
let zoom = 1, targetZoom = 1, pinchStart = 0;

// Lock-mode orbit controls (spherical offset around the locked target)
let lockOrbitTheta = 0;    // horizontal angle around target
let lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;    // vertical angle
let lockOrbitDist = 0;     // set per-body on teleport
let lockTargetDist = 0;
let tLockTheta = 0, tLockPhi = 0.3;

// Transition
let transProgress = 0;
const TRANS_SPEED = 0.045;

let lockedBody = null;   // { planet (mesh), data, pivot? } or { sun: true }
let selectedBody = null; // same, shown in popup before locking

// UI refs
const popup = document.getElementById('selection-popup');
const selName = document.getElementById('sel-name');
const visitBtn = document.getElementById('visit-btn');
const backBtn = document.getElementById('back-btn');
const venusToggleBtn = document.getElementById('venus-toggle-btn');
let venusCloudVisible = true;
let venusCloudMesh = null; // cached reference

venusToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  venusCloudVisible = !venusCloudVisible;
  // Find Venus planet mesh
  const venusEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Venus');
  if (venusEntry) {
    if (!venusCloudMesh) venusCloudMesh = venusEntry.planet.children.find(c => c.userData.isVenusClouds);
    if (venusCloudMesh) {
      // Animate opacity fade
      venusCloudMesh.userData.targetOpacity = venusCloudVisible ? 0.92 : 0;
    }
  }
  venusToggleBtn.textContent = venusCloudVisible ? '☁ Hide Clouds' : '🌑 Show Clouds';
  venusToggleBtn.classList.toggle('surface-mode', !venusCloudVisible);
});

const moonToggleBtn = document.getElementById('moon-toggle-btn');
let lockedOnMoon = false;

const neptuneToggleBtn = document.getElementById('neptune-toggle-btn');
let neptuneTrueColor = false;
let neptuneMesh = null;
let neptuneOrigTex = null;
let neptuneTrueTex = null;

const tritonToggleBtn = document.getElementById('triton-toggle-btn');
let lockedOnTriton = false;

tritonToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  lockedOnTriton = !lockedOnTriton;
  if (lockedOnTriton) {
    lockedBody = { planet: tritonMesh, data: { name: 'Triton', size: TRITON_SIZE }, isTriton: true };
    lockOrbitDist = TRITON_SIZE * 8;
    lockTargetDist = TRITON_SIZE * 8;
    tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
    tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
    mode = 'transitioning'; transProgress = 0; isFirstTransFrame = true;
    lockLabel.textContent = 'Triton';
    tritonToggleBtn.textContent = '🔵 Back to Neptune';
    tritonToggleBtn.classList.add('on-triton');
  } else {
    const nepEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Neptune');
    if (nepEntry) {
      lockedBody = nepEntry;
      lockOrbitDist = nepEntry.data.size * 5.5;
      lockTargetDist = nepEntry.data.size * 5.5;
      tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
      tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
      mode = 'transitioning'; transProgress = 0; isFirstTransFrame = true;
      lockLabel.textContent = 'Neptune';
      tritonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌑 Visit Triton';
      tritonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-triton');
    }
  }
});

const charonToggleBtn = document.getElementById('charon-toggle-btn');
let lockedOnCharon = false;

charonToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  lockedOnCharon = !lockedOnCharon;
  if (lockedOnCharon) {
    lockedBody = { planet: charonMesh, data: { name: 'Charon', size: CHARON_SIZE }, isCharon: true };
    lockOrbitDist = CHARON_SIZE * 8;
    lockTargetDist = CHARON_SIZE * 8;
    tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
    tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
    mode = 'transitioning'; transProgress = 0; isFirstTransFrame = true;
    lockLabel.textContent = 'Charon';
    charonToggleBtn.textContent = '🔵 Back to Pluto';
    charonToggleBtn.classList.add('on-charon');
  } else {
    const plutoEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Pluto');
    if (plutoEntry) {
      lockedBody = plutoEntry;
      lockOrbitDist = plutoEntry.data.size * 7;
      lockTargetDist = plutoEntry.data.size * 7;
      tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
      tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
      mode = 'transitioning'; transProgress = 0; isFirstTransFrame = true;
      lockLabel.textContent = 'Pluto';
      charonToggleBtn.textContent = '🪐 Visit Charon';
      charonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-charon');

  }
});

neptuneToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  neptuneTrueColor = !neptuneTrueColor;

  if (!neptuneMesh) {
    const ne = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Neptune');
    if (ne) neptuneMesh = ne.planet;
  }
  if (!neptuneTrueTex) {
    neptuneTrueTex = loadTex('neptune_true');
  }
  if (!neptuneOrigTex && neptuneMesh) {
    neptuneOrigTex = neptuneMesh.material.map;
  }

  if (neptuneMesh) {
    neptuneMesh.material.map = neptuneTrueColor ? neptuneTrueTex : neptuneOrigTex;
    neptuneMesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  neptuneToggleBtn.textContent = neptuneTrueColor ? '🌌 Voyager Color' : '🔵 True Color';
  neptuneToggleBtn.classList.toggle('true-color', neptuneTrueColor);
});

moonToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  lockedOnMoon = !lockedOnMoon;

  if (lockedOnMoon) {
    // Lock onto Moon
    lockedBody = { planet: moonMesh, data: { name: 'Moon', size: MOON_SIZE }, isMoon: true };
    lockOrbitDist = MOON_SIZE * 7;
    lockTargetDist = MOON_SIZE * 7;
    tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
    tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
    mode = 'transitioning';
    transProgress = 0;
    isFirstTransFrame = true;
    lockLabel.textContent = 'Moon';
    moonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌍 Back to Earth';
    moonToggleBtn.classList.add('on-moon');
  } else {
    // Lock back onto Earth
    const earthEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Earth');
    if (earthEntry) {
      lockedBody = earthEntry;
      lockOrbitDist = earthEntry.data.size * 5.5;
      lockTargetDist = earthEntry.data.size * 5.5;
      tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0;
      tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
      mode = 'transitioning';
      transProgress = 0;
      isFirstTransFrame = true;
      lockLabel.textContent = 'Earth';
      moonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌙 Visit Moon';
      moonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-moon');
    }
  }
});
const lockLabel = document.getElementById('lock-label');
const speedControl = document.getElementById('speed-control');
const hudRight = document.getElementById('hud-right');

function showPopup(body) {
  selectedBody = body;
  selName.textContent = body.data ? body.data.name : 'The Sun';
  popup.classList.add('visible');
}
function hidePopup() {
  popup.classList.remove('visible');
  selectedBody = null;
}

visitBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!selectedBody) return;
  lockedBody = selectedBody;
  hidePopup();
  // Set initial lock orbit distance based on body size
  const sz = lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.size : 8;
  lockOrbitDist = sz * 5.5;
  lockTargetDist = sz * 5.5;
  tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta;
  tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
  mode = 'transitioning';
  transProgress = 0;
  backBtn.classList.add('visible');
  lockLabel.textContent = lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.name : 'The Sun';
  lockLabel.classList.add('visible');
  speedControl.style.opacity = '0.4';
  speedControl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  hudRight.textContent = 'DRAG TO ORBIT';
  findBtn.classList.add('hidden');
  findPanel.classList.remove('visible');
  findPanelOpen = false;
  // Show Venus cloud toggle only when locked onto Venus
  if (lockedBody.data && lockedBody.data.name === 'Venus') {
    venusToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
    venusCloudVisible = true;
    venusToggleBtn.textContent = '☁ Hide Clouds';
    venusToggleBtn.classList.remove('surface-mode');
    if (!venusCloudMesh) {
      const ve = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Venus');
      if (ve) venusCloudMesh = ve.planet.children.find(c => c.userData.isVenusClouds);
    }
    if (venusCloudMesh) { venusCloudMesh.material.opacity = 0.92; venusCloudMesh.userData.targetOpacity = 0.92; }
  }
  if (lockedBody.data && lockedBody.data.name === 'Earth') {
    moonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
    lockedOnMoon = false;
    moonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌙 Visit Moon';
    moonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-moon');
  }
  const pName = lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.name : null;
  if (pName && ['Mars','Jupiter','Saturn','Uranus'].includes(pName)) {
    showFindMoonBtn(pName);
  } else {
    hideFindMoonBtn();
  }
  if (lockedBody.data && lockedBody.data.name === 'Neptune') {
    neptuneToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
    tritonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
    neptuneTrueColor = false;
    neptuneToggleBtn.textContent = '🔵 True Color';
    neptuneToggleBtn.classList.remove('true-color');
    lockedOnTriton = false;
    tritonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌑 Visit Triton';
    tritonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-triton');
    if (!neptuneMesh) {
      const ne = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Neptune');
      if (ne) neptuneMesh = ne.planet;
    }
    if (neptuneMesh) {
      if (!neptuneOrigTex) neptuneOrigTex = neptuneMesh.material.map;
      neptuneMesh.material.map = neptuneOrigTex;
      neptuneMesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }
  if (lockedBody.data && lockedBody.data.name === 'Pluto') {
    charonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
    lockedOnCharon = false;
    charonToggleBtn.textContent = '🪐 Visit Charon';
    charonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-charon');
  }
});

backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  mode = 'overview';
  lockedBody = null;
  backBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  lockLabel.classList.remove('visible');
  venusToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  moonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  neptuneToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  tritonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  charonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  lockedOnMoon = false;
  lockedOnTriton = false;
  lockedOnCharon = false;
  speedControl.style.opacity = '';
  speedControl.style.pointerEvents = '';
  hudRight.textContent = 'DRAG TO ROTATE';
  findBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
  hideFindMoonBtn();
  targetRotX = 0.3; targetRotY = 0;
  targetZoom = 1;
});

// ─── Interaction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function onDragStart(x, y) {
  isDragging = true;
  prevMouse = {x, y};
}
function onDragMove(x, y) {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  const dx = x - prevMouse.x;
  const dy = y - prevMouse.y;
  if (mode === 'overview' || mode === 'transitioning') {
    targetRotY += dx * 0.005;
    targetRotX += dy * 0.005;
    targetRotX = Math.max(-1.2, Math.min(1.2, targetRotX));
  } else if (mode === 'locked') {
    tLockTheta -= dx * 0.007;
    tLockPhi  -= dy * 0.007;
    tLockPhi = Math.max(-Math.PI/2 + 0.05, Math.min(Math.PI/2 - 0.05, tLockPhi));
  }
  prevMouse = {x, y};
}
function onDragEnd() { isDragging = false; }

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => onDragStart(e.clientX, e.clientY));
window.addEventListener('mouseup', onDragEnd);
window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => onDragMove(e.clientX, e.clientY));
canvas.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
  if (mode === 'overview') {
    targetZoom = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(3, targetZoom + e.deltaY * 0.001));
  } else if (mode === 'locked') {
    const sz = lockedBody && lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.size : 8;
    lockTargetDist = Math.max(sz*2.2, Math.min(sz*30, lockTargetDist + e.deltaY * 0.05));
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.touches.length === 1) onDragStart(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
  else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
    isDragging = false;
    pinchStart = Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX-e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY-e.touches[1].clientY);
  }
}, {passive:false});

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.touches.length === 1) onDragMove(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
  else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
    const d = Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX-e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY-e.touches[1].clientY);
    if (mode === 'overview') {
      targetZoom = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(3, targetZoom * (pinchStart/d)));
    } else if (mode === 'locked') {
      const sz = lockedBody && lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.size : 8;
      lockTargetDist = Math.max(sz*2.2, Math.min(sz*30, lockTargetDist * (pinchStart/d)));
    }
    pinchStart = d;
  }
}, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', onDragEnd);

// ─── Raycasting / selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer2 = new THREE.Vector2();
let tapMoved = false, tapStartPos = {x:0, y:0};

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { tapStartPos = {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY}; tapMoved = false; });
window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  if (Math.hypot(e.clientX-tapStartPos.x, e.clientY-tapStartPos.y) > 5) tapMoved = true;
});
canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (tapMoved) return;
  handleTap(e.clientX, e.clientY);
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  if (e.changedTouches.length) handleTap(e.changedTouches[0].clientX, e.changedTouches[0].clientY);
});

function handleTap(x, y) {
  if (mode === 'transitioning') return;
  pointer2.x = (x/window.innerWidth)*2-1;
  pointer2.y = -(y/window.innerHeight)*2+1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer2, camera);

  // Check planets
  const planetMeshes = planets.map(p=>p.planet);
  // Include moon in raycasting
  // Gather all planet system moon meshes
  const sysMoonMeshes = [];
  planetMoonSystems.forEach(sys => sys.moons.forEach(m => sysMoonMeshes.push(m.mesh)));
  const extraMoons = [moonMesh, tritonMesh, charonMesh, ...sysMoonMeshes].filter(Boolean);
  const allMeshes = [...planetMeshes, ...extraMoons];
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(allMeshes, true);
  if (hits.length > 0) {
    let obj = hits[0].object;
    if (obj === moonMesh) {
      showPopup({ planet: moonMesh, data: { name: 'Moon', size: MOON_SIZE }, isMoon: true });
      return;
    }
    if (obj.userData.isMoon && obj.userData.moonName) {
      showPopup({ planet: obj, data: { name: obj.userData.moonName, size: obj.userData.moonSize }, isMoon: true });
      return;
    }
    if (obj === tritonMesh || obj.userData.isTriton) {
      showPopup({ planet: tritonMesh, data: { name: 'Triton', size: TRITON_SIZE }, isTriton: true });
      return;
    }
    if (obj === charonMesh || obj.userData.isCharon) {
      showPopup({ planet: charonMesh, data: { name: 'Charon', size: CHARON_SIZE }, isCharon: true });
      return;
    }
    while (obj.parent && !planetMeshes.includes(obj)) obj = obj.parent;
    const idx = planetMeshes.indexOf(obj);
    if (idx >= 0) { showPopup(planets[idx]); return; }
  }
  // Check sun
  const sunHits = raycaster.intersectObject(sun);
  if (sunHits.length > 0) {
    showPopup({ planet: sun, data: null, isSun: true });
    return;
  }
  // Tap on empty space — hide popup
  hidePopup();
}

// ─── Speed ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ─── Find Object Panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const findBtn = document.getElementById('find-btn');
const findPanel = document.getElementById('find-panel');
let findPanelOpen = false;

findBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  findPanelOpen = !findPanelOpen;
  findPanel.classList.toggle('visible', findPanelOpen);
});

// Close panel on outside tap
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (findPanelOpen && !findPanel.contains(e.target) && e.target !== findBtn) {
    findPanelOpen = false;
    findPanel.classList.remove('visible');
  }
});

// Handle item clicks
document.querySelectorAll('.find-item').forEach(item => {
  item.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const bodyName = item.dataset.body;
    findPanelOpen = false;
    findPanel.classList.remove('visible');

    let targetBody = null;

    if (bodyName === 'Sun') {
      targetBody = { planet: sun, data: null, isSun: true };
    } else {
      const entry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === bodyName);
      if (entry) targetBody = entry;
    }

    if (!targetBody) return;

    // Lock onto the selected body
    lockedBody = targetBody;
    const sz = targetBody.data ? targetBody.data.size : 8;
    lockOrbitDist = sz * 5.5;
    lockTargetDist = sz * 5.5;
    tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0.4;
    tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
    mode = 'transitioning';
    transProgress = 0;
    isFirstTransFrame = true;

    backBtn.classList.add('visible');
    lockLabel.textContent = targetBody.data ? targetBody.data.name : 'The Sun';
    lockLabel.classList.add('visible');
    speedControl.style.opacity = '0.4';
    speedControl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    hudRight.textContent = 'DRAG TO ORBIT';
    findBtn.classList.add('hidden');

    // Show relevant sub-buttons
    venusToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
    moonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
    neptuneToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
    tritonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');
    charonToggleBtn.classList.remove('visible');

    if (bodyName === 'Venus') {
      venusToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
      venusCloudVisible = true;
      venusToggleBtn.textContent = '☁ Hide Clouds';
      venusToggleBtn.classList.remove('surface-mode');
      if (!venusCloudMesh) {
        const ve = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Venus');
        if (ve) venusCloudMesh = ve.planet.children.find(c => c.userData.isVenusClouds);
      }
      if (venusCloudMesh) { venusCloudMesh.material.opacity = 0.92; venusCloudMesh.userData.targetOpacity = 0.92; }
    }
    if (bodyName === 'Earth') {
      moonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
      lockedOnMoon = false;
      moonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌙 Visit Moon';
      moonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-moon');
    }
    if (['Mars','Jupiter','Saturn','Uranus'].includes(bodyName)) {
      showFindMoonBtn(bodyName);
    }
    if (bodyName === 'Neptune') {
      neptuneToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
      tritonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
      neptuneTrueColor = false;
      neptuneToggleBtn.textContent = '🔵 True Color';
      neptuneToggleBtn.classList.remove('true-color');
      lockedOnTriton = false;
      tritonToggleBtn.textContent = '🌑 Visit Triton';
      tritonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-triton');
      if (!neptuneMesh) {
        const ne = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Neptune');
        if (ne) neptuneMesh = ne.planet;
      }
      if (neptuneMesh) {
        if (!neptuneOrigTex) neptuneOrigTex = neptuneMesh.material.map;
        neptuneMesh.material.map = neptuneOrigTex;
        neptuneMesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    }
    if (bodyName === 'Pluto') {
      charonToggleBtn.classList.add('visible');
      lockedOnCharon = false;
      charonToggleBtn.textContent = '🪐 Visit Charon';
      charonToggleBtn.classList.remove('on-charon');
    }
  });
});

// ─── Find Moon Panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const findMoonBtn = document.getElementById('find-moon-btn');
const findMoonPanel = document.getElementById('find-moon-panel');
const moonList = document.getElementById('moon-list');
let findMoonPanelOpen = false;
let currentPlanetMoons = []; // moons of currently locked planet

findMoonBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  findMoonPanelOpen = !findMoonPanelOpen;
  findMoonPanel.classList.toggle('visible', findMoonPanelOpen);
});

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (findMoonPanelOpen && !findMoonPanel.contains(e.target) && e.target !== findMoonBtn) {
    findMoonPanelOpen = false;
    findMoonPanel.classList.remove('visible');
  }
});

function buildMoonList(planetName) {
  const sys = planetMoonSystems.find(s => s.planetName === planetName);
  // Also add triton for Neptune, charon for Pluto (handled separately)
  moonList.innerHTML = '';
  currentPlanetMoons = [];
  if (!sys) return;
  sys.moons.forEach(moonEntry => {
    currentPlanetMoons.push(moonEntry);
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'moon-item';
    item.innerHTML = `<span class="moon-emoji">${moonEntry.data.emoji}</span>${moonEntry.data.name}`;
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      findMoonPanelOpen = false;
      findMoonPanel.classList.remove('visible');
      // Teleport to this moon
      lockedBody = { planet: moonEntry.mesh, data: { name: moonEntry.data.name, size: moonEntry.data.size }, isMoon: true, parentPlanet: planetName };
      lockOrbitDist = moonEntry.data.size * 9;
      lockTargetDist = moonEntry.data.size * 9;
      tLockTheta = lockOrbitTheta = 0.3;
      tLockPhi = lockOrbitPhi = 0.3;
      mode = 'transitioning'; transProgress = 0; isFirstTransFrame = true;
      lockLabel.textContent = moonEntry.data.name;
      // Hide find moon btn while on a moon — show back btn
      findMoonBtn.classList.remove('visible');
    });
    moonList.appendChild(item);
  });
}

function showFindMoonBtn(planetName) {
  buildMoonList(planetName);
  if (currentPlanetMoons.length > 0) {
    findMoonBtn.classList.add('visible');
  }
}
function hideFindMoonBtn() {
  findMoonBtn.classList.remove('visible');
  findMoonPanel.classList.remove('visible');
  findMoonPanelOpen = false;
}

const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speed-slider');
let speedMult = 1;
speedSlider.addEventListener('input', () => speedMult = parseFloat(speedSlider.value));

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const _worldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
function getBodyWorldPos(body) {
  if (body.isSun) return new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0);
  body.planet.getWorldPosition(_worldPos);
  return _worldPos.clone();
}
// Also allow tapping the moon
function getMoonWorldPos() {
  if (!moonMesh) return null;
  moonMesh.getWorldPosition(_worldPos);
  return _worldPos.clone();
}

// ─── Animation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
// Smooth camera target for transition
let camFrom = new THREE.Vector3();
let camFromLookAt = new THREE.Vector3();
let isFirstTransFrame = true;

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = clock.getDelta();
  const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

  // Advance planet orbits always
  planets.forEach(({pivot, planet, data}) => {
    pivot.rotation.y += dt * data.speed * 0.12 * speedMult;
    planet.rotation.y += dt * 0.3;
    // Rotate clouds slightly faster than Earth surface
    if (data.atmos) {
      const cloud = planet.children.find(c => c.userData.isCloud);
      if (cloud) cloud.rotation.y += dt * 0.035;
    }
    // Rotate Venus clouds (retrograde, slow)
    if (data.name === 'Venus') {
      const vc = planet.children.find(c => c.userData.isVenusClouds);
      if (vc) vc.rotation.y -= dt * 0.018;
    }
  });
  sun.rotation.y += dt * 0.05;
  sun.scale.setScalar(1 + 0.025 * Math.sin(elapsed * 1.5));


  // Moon orbit around Earth
  if (moonPivot) {
    moonPivot.rotation.y += dt * 0.6 * speedMult;
    if (moonMesh) moonMesh.rotation.y += dt * 0.05;
  }

  // All planet moon systems
  planetMoonSystems.forEach(sys => {
    sys.moons.forEach(({ data, pivot, mesh }) => {
      pivot.rotation.y += dt * data.speed * 0.3 * speedMult;
      mesh.rotation.y += dt * 0.1;
    });
  });

  // Triton orbit around Neptune (retrograde)
  if (tritonPivot) {
    tritonPivot.rotation.y -= dt * 0.5 * speedMult;
    if (tritonMesh) tritonMesh.rotation.y += dt * 0.04;
  }

  // Pluto-Charon mutual orbit (tidally locked — same period, face each other)
  if (charonPivot) {
    // Rotate the barycenter group — both Pluto and Charon orbit together
    charonPivot.rotation.y += dt * 0.45 * speedMult;
    // Self-rotation (tidally locked, so spin = orbit rate)
    if (charonMesh) charonMesh.rotation.y += dt * 0.04;
    const plutoEntry = planets.find(p => p.data.name === 'Pluto');
    if (plutoEntry) plutoEntry.planet.rotation.y += dt * 0.04;
  }

  // Smooth Venus cloud opacity fade
  if (venusCloudMesh && venusCloudMesh.userData.targetOpacity !== undefined) {
    const target = venusCloudMesh.userData.targetOpacity;
    venusCloudMesh.material.opacity += (target - venusCloudMesh.material.opacity) * 0.06;
  }

  if (mode === 'overview') {
    // Smooth overview rotation
    rotX += (targetRotX - rotX) * 0.08;
    rotY += (targetRotY - rotY) * 0.08;
    zoom += (targetZoom - zoom) * 0.08;
    systemGroup.rotation.x = rotX;
    systemGroup.rotation.y = rotY;
    camera.position.set(0, 60 * zoom, 130 * zoom);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

  } else if (mode === 'transitioning') {
    if (isFirstTransFrame) {
      camFrom.copy(camera.position);
      isFirstTransFrame = false;
    }
    transProgress = Math.min(1, transProgress + TRANS_SPEED);
    const t = smoothstep(transProgress);

    // Get target body world position
    const bodyPos = getBodyWorldPos(lockedBody);
    const sz = lockedBody.data ? lockedBody.data.size : 8;
    const dist = sz * 5.5;

    // Target camera position: offset from body
    const tCam = new THREE.Vector3(
      bodyPos.x + dist * Math.cos(lockOrbitPhi) * Math.sin(lockOrbitTheta),
      bodyPos.y + dist * Math.sin(lockOrbitPhi),
      bodyPos.z + dist * Math.cos(lockOrbitPhi) * Math.cos(lockOrbitTheta)
    );

    camera.position.lerpVectors(camFrom, tCam, t);
    camera.lookAt(bodyPos);

    if (transProgress >= 1) {
      mode = 'locked';
      isFirstTransFrame = true;
    }

  } else if (mode === 'locked') {
    // Smooth lock orbit angles
    lockOrbitTheta += (tLockTheta - lockOrbitTheta) * 0.1;
    lockOrbitPhi   += (tLockPhi   - lockOrbitPhi)   * 0.1;
    lockOrbitDist  += (lockTargetDist - lockOrbitDist) * 0.1;

    const bodyPos = getBodyWorldPos(lockedBody);

    camera.position.set(
      bodyPos.x + lockOrbitDist * Math.cos(lockOrbitPhi) * Math.sin(lockOrbitTheta),
      bodyPos.y + lockOrbitDist * Math.sin(lockOrbitPhi),
      bodyPos.z + lockOrbitDist * Math.cos(lockOrbitPhi) * Math.cos(lockOrbitTheta)
    );
    camera.lookAt(bodyPos);
    // Keep systemGroup rotation neutral so stars still look right
    systemGroup.rotation.x = 0;
    systemGroup.rotation.y = 0;
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

function smoothstep(t) {
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

animate();

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
